{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive values (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices after spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (e.g., <0.00), especially if model has overcorrected upward.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, adjust next period’s forecast downward by 3-5% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Avoid overshooting after sharp price spikes — cap forecast peaks at 10-15% below recent high if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "When sentiment history includes a recent +0.50, reduce forecast by 5-8% to account for potential market cooling.",
    "If model consistently overpredicts prices in the first 5-7 days of a new cycle, apply a 10-15% downward bias to early forecast points."
  ]
}
